effect_en: Choose a starter card you played this turn. If it is Prep, gain 2 Time. If it is Simple Soup, it gets +2 Taste this turn.
effect_fr: Choisissez une carte de depart que vous avez jouee ce tour-ci. Si c'est Preparation, gagnez 2 Temps. Si c'est Soupe simple, elle gagne +2 Gout ce tour-ci.
notes: Core compression.

effect_en: Choose one - Peel up to 2 starter cards; or Peel Clean Station.
effect_fr: Choisissez une option - Epluchez jusqu'a 2 cartes de depart; ou Epluchez Plan de travail propre.
notes: Self-cleans once starter cards are gone.

effect_en: Draw 3 then discard 1. If the discarded card is a starter card or Status, you may Peel it.
effect_fr: Piochez 3 puis defaussez 1. Si la carte defaussee est une carte de depart ou un Statut, vous pouvez l'Eplucher.
notes: Core smoothing pushed for v2.

effect_en: Each opponent gains a Distraction. If there is only one opponent, they gain 2 Distractions instead.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire gagne une Distraction. S'il n'y a qu'un adversaire, il gagne 2 Distractions a la place.
notes: Simple status attack scaled for multiplayer.

effect_en: Choose a Dish. Double its Taste this turn.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat. Doublez son Gout ce tour-ci.
notes: French one-perfect-dish moment.

effect_en: Choose an opponent's highest-Taste presented dish. It gets -2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.
effect_fr: Choisissez le plat presente avec le plus de Gout chez un adversaire. Il gagne -2 Gout ce tour-ci. Piochez 1.
notes: French critique interaction.

effect_en: Choose an opponent's presented dish. If it is not French it gets -3 Taste this turn and its owner gains Food Coma.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat adverse presente. S'il n'est pas Francais il gagne -3 Gout ce tour-ci et son proprietaire gagne Coma alimentaire.
notes: Butter as hostile excess and status pressure.

effect_en: Reveal a Dish from your hand. If it has more Taste than an opponent's presented dish that dish gets -3 Taste this turn.
effect_fr: Revelez un plat de votre main. S'il a plus de Gout qu'un plat adverse presente ce plat gagne -3 Gout ce tour-ci.
notes: Comparison card that benefits from persistent opponent boards.

effect_en: Draw 1. During judging if one of your dishes has 5 or more Taste gain +2 Favor.
effect_fr: Piochez 1. Au jugement si l'un de vos plats a au moins 5 Gout gagnez +2 Faveur.
notes: French high-quality payoff.

effect_en: During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.
effect_fr: Au jugement copiez l'un de vos plats comme plat presente supplementaire.
notes: Wild excess card.

effect_en: Your Meat dishes get +1 Taste this turn. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.
effect_fr: Vos plats Viande gagnent +1 Gout ce tour-ci. Au jugement si vous presentez au moins 2 plats Viande gagnez +2 Faveur.
notes: Meat bridge payoff.

effect_en: Choose a Dish. It becomes Fried this turn and gets +2 Taste.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat. Il devient Friture ce tour-ci et gagne +2 Gout.
notes: Temporarily bends tags.

effect_en: Draw 1 and gain 1 Time. During judging if you present at least 3 dishes gain +2 Favor.
effect_fr: Piochez 1 et gagnez 1 Temps. Au jugement si vous presentez au moins 3 plats gagnez +2 Faveur.
notes: Rewards volume and adds Time.

effect_en: Choose a Meat or Fried dish. It gets +2 Taste.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat Viande ou Friture. Il gagne +2 Gout.
notes: Condiment as action rather than dish.

effect_en: Choose an opponent's presented dish. After that opponent scores, steal that dish and add it to your discard pile. Peel Appropriate.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat presente d'un adversaire. Apres le score de cet adversaire, volez ce plat et ajoutez-le a votre defausse. Epluchez Appropriation.
notes: Unrestricted story card.

effect_en: Peel up to 2 cards. If you Peel a Status this way, draw 1.
effect_fr: Epluchez jusqu'a 2 cartes. Si vous Epluchez un Statut ainsi, piochez 1.
notes: Japanese cleanup with status reward.

effect_en: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
effect_fr: Regardez les 5 premieres cartes de votre deck. Mettez-en 2 dans votre main et le reste sous votre deck dans l'ordre de votre choix.
notes: Strong Japanese card selection.

effect_en: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand and discard the rest. You may present that Dish this turn. During judging if your meal completes all 3 core courses, gain +2 Favor.
effect_fr: Revelez des cartes de votre deck jusqu'a reveler un Plat. Mettez-le dans votre main et defaussez le reste. Vous pouvez presenter ce Plat ce tour-ci. Au jugement si votre repas complete les 3 plats de base, gagnez +2 Faveur.
notes: Big precision moment.

effect_en: During judging if you present exactly Appetizer Main and Dessert with no duplicate core course gain +5 Favor.
effect_fr: Au jugement si vous presentez exactement Entree Plat et Dessert sans doublon de plat de base gagnez +5 Faveur.
notes: Japanese exactness payoff.

effect_en: Choose an opponent's dish. It gets -1 Taste. If it is not Seafood it gets -3 Taste instead. Its owner Scorches 1.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat d'un adversaire. Il gagne -1 Gout. S'il n'est pas Fruits de mer il gagne -3 Gout a la place. Son proprietaire Carbonise 1.
notes: Sharp reaction with brutal Scorch rider.

effect_en: Draw 1. If the Judge does not favor you, draw 2 and gain 1 Time instead.
effect_fr: Piochez 1. Si le Juge ne vous favorise pas, piochez 2 et gagnez 1 Temps a la place.
notes: Comeback fuel.

effect_en: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand and discard the rest, then draw 1. You may present that Dish this turn. If the Judge does not favor you, gain 1 Time.
effect_fr: Revelez des cartes de votre deck jusqu'a reveler un Plat. Mettez-le dans votre main et defaussez le reste, puis piochez 1. Vous pouvez presenter ce Plat ce tour-ci. Si le Juge ne vous favorise pas, gagnez 1 Temps.
notes: Find missing dish plus extra card flow.

effect_en: During judging score one Main a second time.
effect_fr: Au jugement scorez une deuxieme fois un Plat principal.
notes: Wild Italian long-meal card.

name_fr: Casser les spaghetti est un crime
effect_en: Each opponent who modified a dish this turn gains Shame. Choose one modified dish; it gets -2 Taste.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire qui a modifie un plat ce tour-ci gagne Honte. Choisissez un plat modifie; il gagne -2 Gout.
notes: Broader multiplayer punishment for modifier decks.

effect_en: Choose a Tomato or Cheese dish. It gets +2 Taste. If the Judge does not favor you, it gets +3 Taste instead.
effect_fr: Choisissez un plat Tomate ou Fromage. Il gagne +2 Gout. Si le Juge ne vous favorise pas, il gagne +3 Gout a la place.
notes: Italian boost.

effect_en: Choose a Main. It gets +2 Taste. If it is Cheese or Tomato it gets +3 Taste instead.
effect_fr: Choisissez un Plat. Il gagne +2 Gout. Si c'est Fromage ou Tomate il gagne +3 Gout a la place.
notes: Cheese modifier moved from dish to action.

effect_en: Rotate up to 3 cards in the market. Draw 1. Gain 1 Time.
effect_fr: Renouvelez jusqu'a 3 cartes du marche. Piochez 1. Gagnez 1 Temps.
notes: Shop churn plus cantrip.

effect_en: Choose an opponent. They gain a Yelp Review. Draw 1.
effect_fr: Choisissez un adversaire. Il gagne Avis Yelp. Piochez 1.
notes: Status interaction; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Rotate the whole market.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire gagne Inspection sanitaire. Renouvelez tout le marche.
notes: Brutal status plus shop reset; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Until your next turn, opponents cannot steal your dishes. If any opponent has more Favor than you, gain 1 Time.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire gagne Inspection sanitaire. Jusqu'a votre prochain tour, les adversaires ne peuvent pas voler vos plats. Si un adversaire a plus de Faveur que vous, gagnez 1 Temps.
notes: American political satire; generated v1 art.

name_fr: Les refills de la liberte ne sont pas gratuits
effect_en: Gain 2 Time. Each opponent gains Food Coma. During judging if you present an Extra gain +1 Favor.
effect_fr: Gagnez 2 Temps. Chaque adversaire gagne Coma alimentaire. Au jugement si vous presentez un Extra gagnez +1 Faveur.
notes: Time burst with collateral damage; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Each opponent gains Strike. You may Peel a starter card.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire gagne Greve. Vous pouvez Eplucher une carte de depart.
notes: French labor cliche and cleanup; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Each opponent Scorches 1. For each Status Scorched this way, draw 1.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire Carbonise 1. Pour chaque Statut Carbonise ainsi, piochez 1.
notes: Brutal public shaming Scorch effect; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Cancel one Taste reduction or opponent modifier on one of your dishes. That opponent gains Shame.
effect_fr: Annulez une reduction de Gout ou un modificateur adverse sur un de vos plats. Cet adversaire gagne Honte.
notes: Protective Italian reaction; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Each opponent who presented or modified a Tomato or Cheese dish this turn gains Shame. If any of those dishes is American, its owner also gains a Distraction.
effect_fr: Chaque adversaire qui a presente ou modifie un plat Tomate ou Fromage ce tour-ci gagne Honte. Si l'un de ces plats est Americain, son proprietaire gagne aussi une Distraction.
notes: Pizza culture-war card; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Draw 3 then discard 2. If you discarded a Status, gain 1 Time.
effect_fr: Piochez 3 puis defaussez 2. Si vous avez defausse un Statut, gagnez 1 Temps.
notes: Neutral rummage for status-heavy decks; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and discard the rest.
effect_fr: Regardez les 6 premieres cartes de votre deck. Mettez-en 2 dans votre main et defaussez le reste.
notes: Big selection with discard setup; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and discard the rest. Gain a Distraction.
effect_fr: Regardez les 5 premieres cartes de votre deck. Mettez-en 2 dans votre main et defaussez le reste. Gagnez une Distraction.
notes: Cheap selection with a silly status downside; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Draw 2. Choose a Dish on your board; it gets +1 Taste this turn.
effect_fr: Piochez 2. Choisissez un Plat sur votre board; il gagne +1 Gout ce tour-ci.
notes: French draw plus quality polish; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Draw 2. Each opponent may draw 1; each who does gains Food Coma.
effect_fr: Piochez 2. Chaque adversaire peut piocher 1; chacun qui le fait gagne Coma alimentaire.
notes: Tempting multiplayer draw with junk-food downside; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 1 into your hand. You may discard any Statuses among the rest. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
effect_fr: Regardez les 4 premieres cartes de votre deck. Mettez-en 1 dans votre main. Vous pouvez defausser les Statuts parmi le reste. Mettez le reste sous votre deck dans l'ordre de votre choix.
notes: Japanese selection and status filtering; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Put a Dish from your discard pile into your hand. Draw 1. If it is Tomato or Cheese, gain 1 Time.
effect_fr: Mettez un Plat de votre defausse dans votre main. Piochez 1. S'il est Tomate ou Fromage, gagnez 1 Temps.
notes: Italian recursion and draw; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Play a card from your Fridge. If it is a Dish, it gets +2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.
effect_fr: Jouez une carte de votre Frigo. Si c'est un Plat, il gagne +2 Gout ce tour-ci. Piochez 1.
notes: Fridge payoff that turns saved cards into tempo; generated v1 art.

effect_en: Look at an opponent's Fridge. You may discard that card. If you do, that opponent gains Food Coma.
effect_fr: Regardez le Frigo d'un adversaire. Vous pouvez defausser cette carte. Si vous le faites, cet adversaire gagne Coma alimentaire.
notes: Brutal Fridge interaction for short silly games; generated v1 art.
